title: Fermented Salmon Crumble
description: A delicious and healthy salmon dish with a flavorful crumble topping.
instructions: Season the salmon fillet with salt and pepper.
Heat the Syrian olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the fermented cabbage to the skillet and cook until softened.
Place the salmon fillet on top of the cabbage mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes or until the salmon is cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the breadcrumbs, crumbled feta cheese, and chopped parsley in a bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top the salmon with the breadcrumb mixture.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve immediately.
